item.title: Kilcoo progress to Ulster Senior Club Football Final after win over Erne Gaels - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: Ulster giants Kilcoo have beaten Erne Gaels 4-12 to 1-10 in this evening’s Ulster Senior Club Championship Semi-Final. Francis Mooney was at the Box-IT Athletic Grounds for Highland Radio Sport this evening…
